content:
laura_sales: Kicking off MeadowHealth perf sync — they want mixed text-gen + embeddings stress, SSO & KMS validation, and a ballpark pricing estimate. Can we confirm run plan? @devon_se @matt_sre :chart_with_upwards_trend:

devon_se: Suggest 3 phases: 1) smoke (5m, 10 qps) 2) sustained (30m, 150 qps) 3) burst (5m spikes to 400 qps). Target p95 < 400ms gen tokens, embeddings p95 < 60ms. We'll capture token/time breakdowns.

matt_sre: Sounds good. For SSO/KMS we need to ensure private key access won't add >5% tail. I'll run a test with wrapped KMS calls.

olivia_engineer: I've prepared the load harness. Using vegeta + a simple runner that posts to /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings. Example command:

olivia_engineer: ```bash
vegeta attack -rate 150 -duration 30m -targets targets.txt | vegeta report -type json > report.json
# targets.txt contains two endpoints with weights: 80% /generate, 20% /embeddings
```

jordan_sales_eng: Client asked about cost for sustained 150 qps for 30m and a 400 qps 5m spike — rough cents-per-1000-tokens? Need a slide for tomorrow.

devon_se: We'll produce a conservative cost estimate: assume 10 tokens/request gen avg, embeddings 512 tokens cost unit. I'll attach sample math after run.

benchbot: scheduled load job meadow-61888 at 2024-07-27T15:14:00Z (job id m-20240727-1) :white_check_mark:

matt_sre: Quick note: enable TLS inspection bypass for KMS tests or we'll see artificial latency. Also record tail latencies (99th).

olivia_engineer: Run completed. Key excerpts from report:

olivia_engineer: ```json
{"requests":540000,"success_rate":0.998,"p50":120,"p95":380,"p99":890,"avg_tokens_per_req":9.7}
```

laura_sales: This looks promising. p95 within target for gen but p99 high — need to call out for SRE/ops. Also prepare an ops doc for multi-zone failover to keep 99th down.

devon_se: Action items: 1) replay with KMS enabled (dev region) 2) run dedicated GPU variant (quantized) to show cost delta 3) prepare pricing slide with tokens->$ mapping and sensitivity for spikes.

jordan_sales_eng: I'll draft the slide and include a "fast-follow" pricing appendix. Can we get the KMS run by EOD?

matt_sre: I'll queue it, should finish before EOD. tagging @olivia_engineer for the harness tweak.

olivia_engineer: On it. I'll share the raw report link when available. :thumbsup:

laura_sales: Thanks team — I'll update MeadowHealth and set a 10am demo tomorrow. cc @jordan_sales_eng
